title: Resize, a tragedy in one act
music: playful curious explainer music, light pizzicato strings, soft marimba and warm synth pad, gentle groove, 100 bpm

lines.direction: Enter the saga, bearing a resize
lines.say: I bear a resize. Whither, good sirs?
To me, as ever: a save, with status RESIZED.
Not while the resize flag is on. Then it comes to me.
Take it. Crop stays mine, and resize returns if the flag goes off.

scenes.text: Exit resize, pursued by a toggle.
scenes.sub: Flag off: back to the BFF.
